appearances.title: Hugging Face reproduces weight-space programming with ML Intern
appearances.summary: Hugging Face reproduced the weight-space programming result using ML Intern, an open-source harness for AI research and training. They published an edited Qwen3.5-0.8B checkpoint and a demo. Hugging Face reposted the result.
appearances.doubt: The reproduction confirms the number, not the cause: the earlier retest argues most of the gain comes from fixing the base model's thinking-mode loops (47% unedited in non-thinking mode). @CanyuChen3 also raises safety concerns about agents editing parameters directly.

appearances.title: GPT-6 Astra edits model weights without training
appearances.summary: GPT-6 Astra changed 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights with no gradients or training, stopping reasoning loops and raising math scores by up to 6x and instruction following by 3x. The same writeup shows it naming game policies from raw weights, patching a stuck control policy, and writing a Breakout network that scored 20x a PPO run trained for 500M steps. The edited model is on the Hub.
appearances.doubt: The reproduction confirms the number, not the cause: the earlier retest argues most of the gain comes from fixing the base model's thinking-mode loops (47% unedited in non-thinking mode). @CanyuChen3 also raises safety concerns about agents editing parameters directly.
